response.sql: WITH site_mesh_stats AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat, AVG(CAST(sm.facetresmm AS REAL) / sm.geomdeltamm) as site_avg_ratio FROM scanmesh sm INNER JOIN sites s ON sm.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL AND sm.facetresmm IS NOT NULL AND sm.geomdeltamm IS NOT NULL AND sm.geomdeltamm > 0 GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat), status_averages AS (SELECT insurstat, AVG(site_avg_ratio) as status_avg_ratio FROM site_mesh_stats GROUP BY insurstat), above_average_sites AS (SELECT sms.insurstat, sms.site_avg_ratio, sa.status_avg_ratio FROM site_mesh_stats sms JOIN status_averages sa ON sms.insurstat = sa.insurstat WHERE sms.site_avg_ratio > sa.status_avg_ratio) SELECT aas.insurstat, AVG(aas.site_avg_ratio) as above_avg_sites_average_ratio, COUNT(*) as above_avg_sites_count, AVG(aas.site_avg_ratio) - MAX(aas.status_avg_ratio) as average_excess FROM above_average_sites aas GROUP BY aas.insurstat
